text:
### Access Control  
**Role-Based Access:**
- Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service
- Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes
- Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)
- Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)  
**Authentication:**
- Multi-factor authentication for admin/compliance access
- Username/password + OTP
- Audit logging of all access
name: Chunk 19/36

raw_entities.name: Access Control Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing role-based access to customer and operational data across the organisation. Defines access permissions by staff role, authentication requirements, and audit logging obligations to protect data confidentiality and integrity.
context: Role-Based Access: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service
Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes
Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)
Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff Data Access Limitation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement restricting customer-facing staff access to only the customer data necessary to deliver service. Prevents unnecessary exposure of personal information.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff Full Data Access for Regulatory Purposes
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement granting compliance staff full access to organisational data to fulfil regulatory obligations and conduct compliance monitoring.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes

raw_entities.name: Technology Staff Database Access with Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement permitting technology staff database access while requiring comprehensive audit logging of all database access events for accountability and security monitoring.
context: Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)

raw_entities.name: Executive Access to Aggregated Data Only
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement restricting executive access to aggregated data summaries, explicitly prohibiting access to personal customer details to maintain data minimisation principles.
context: Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Admin and Compliance Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement implementing multi-factor authentication (username/password plus OTP) for all administrative and compliance staff accessing sensitive systems and data.
context: Multi-factor authentication for admin/compliance access
Username/password + OTP

raw_entities.name: Audit Logging of All Access Events
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to maintain comprehensive audit logs of all access to systems and data, enabling detection of unauthorised access and supporting compliance investigations.
context: Audit logging of all access

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication System
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring username/password credentials combined with one-time password (OTP) authentication for administrative and compliance staff accessing sensitive systems.
context: Multi-factor authentication for admin/compliance access
Username/password + OTP

raw_entities.name: Access Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: Operational control recording all access events to systems and data, including technology staff database access and all user authentication events, for security monitoring and compliance verification.
context: Database access (with audit logging)
Audit logging of all access

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff role with responsibility to access only customer data necessary for service delivery, subject to role-based access controls limiting data exposure.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff role with responsibility for regulatory compliance, granted full organisational data access to conduct compliance monitoring, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes

raw_entities.name: Technology Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff role responsible for database and system administration, granted database access subject to comprehensive audit logging of all access events.
context: Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)

raw_entities.name: Executives
raw_entities.description: Senior management role restricted to access of aggregated data summaries only, explicitly prohibited from accessing personal customer details.
context: Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorised Data Access
raw_entities.description: Risk of staff accessing customer or operational data beyond their role-based permissions, potentially exposing sensitive information or enabling fraud.
context: Role-Based Access: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service
Audit logging of all access

raw_entities.name: Compliance Failure Due to Insufficient Data Access
raw_entities.description: Risk that compliance staff lack necessary data access to fulfil regulatory obligations, resulting in incomplete investigations or failed regulatory reporting.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes
